title: Fee Basis for a Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) Fee Charged Again, by How the Certificate Ended
content:
**Rule.** Under Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44), a fee charged again is the fee charged on a filing whose fee charges were all reversed in full as charged in error. It is built on a re-charge fee basis. That basis follows how the filing's coverage with the state ended, read from the filing's own SR-26 date and certificate end date, both as they stand on the posting date.

**Input, judgement, output**

| Does the filing carry an SR-26 date? | Certificate end date against the posting date | Re-charge fee basis |
|---|---|---|
| no (its backing coverage has not ended) | not read | Cardinal Point's flat filing fee for a fee charged again |
| yes | on or after the posting date (the driver is still certified) | half that flat fee, rounded up to the next whole dollar |
| yes | before the posting date (the certification has lapsed) | one and a half times that flat fee, rounded down to the whole dollar |

**Boundaries.**

- **End date equals the posting date.** The end date is on the posting date, so the half basis applies.
- **End date one day before.** The certification has lapsed, so the one-and-a-half basis applies. No count of days beyond that is read.

**Rounding shown on hypothetical flat fees (not schedule values)**

- *Flat fee of 23.00.* Half is 11.50, rounded up to 12. One and a half times is 34.50, rounded down to 34.
- *Flat fee of 22.00.* Half is 11.00, already whole, so it stays 11.
